inputs: public sources on Fixed Share, mixability-gap/AdaHedge, online variance-reduction mixtures, and AdaNormalHedge.TV
actions: Instantiated the Fixed Share path coding term for J=3 and switching comparators.
Derived exact fixed-eta realized-loss certificate H_T-L_path <= C_T/eta + Delta_T, avoiding the looser Hoeffding eta*T/8 term.
Mapped the certificate through B=25/9 to expected cumulative proposal second moment/variance for fixed or predictable comparator paths.
Compared conventional theorem-tuned Fixed Share, aggressive Fixed Share, Variable Share variants, and AdaNormalHedge.TV on independent recurring-drift synthetic validation.
Validated the realized aggressive Fixed Share certificate on 1000 independent synthetic runs with a phasewise comparator path fixed independently of realized sampling noise.
Persisted certificate, r114 checkpoint, and advanced role-local LATEST using CAS/readback-safe sequencing.
material_result: Conventional worst-case eta tuning is too conservative in the current finite rare-event abstraction, but aggressive eta=16 can still be audited ex post by the realized mixability-gap certificate. In 300 recurring-drift synthetic validations it reached 187.9128 cumulative variance units versus 197.2654 for theorem-tuned Fixed Share and 184.5942 for the phasewise oracle. Across 1000 certificate validations, B*(C/eta+Delta) had median 5.1572 and q95 5.8913 variance units while observed comparator-regret q95 was 4.8935.
scope_and_blockers: Synthetic evidence only; no real agent/production or AGI conclusion.
True-variance mapping for a comparator selected retrospectively from the same randomized loss stream still needs uniform inference.
Aggressive eta can fail if realized mixability gap Delta grows; certificate-triggered fallback/restart is not yet derived.
Dependent resampling, random particle counts and agent-specific multifidelity validation remain open.
termination_cause: physical invocation checkpoint after material frontier advance; continuing research frontier remains nonempty
exact_next_action: Prove a per-epoch Fixed Share certificate with explicit restart/path coding cost and implement a predeclared eta ladder such as {16,8,4,2,1}, retaining eta=16 while B*(C/eta+Delta) stays within budget and restarting/downshifting only on certificate breach. Compare on abrupt, gradual, recurring and proxy-degradation drift; in parallel add time-uniform second-moment inference for data-dependent comparator selection.
